verses.text: "Do you think it is right for you to say, 'I am more right than God'?
You ask him, 'What good does it do me? What do I gain by not sinning?'
I will answer you, and your friends with you.
Look up at the sky and see. Look at the clouds high above you.
If you sin, how does that hurt God? If you sin again and again, what does that do to him?
If you do what is right, what do you give him? What does he receive from you?
Your evil only hurts people like yourself, and your good deeds only help other humans.
People cry out when they are crushed by cruelty. They call for help against the power of the strong.
But no one says, 'Where is God my Maker, who gives us songs in the night,
who teaches us more than he teaches the animals, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?'
They cry out, but he does not answer, because of the pride of evil people.
God does not listen to their empty cries. The Almighty pays no attention to them.
So he will surely not listen when you say you cannot see him, that your case is before him and you are waiting for him.
And now you say that he does not punish in his anger and does not pay much attention to sin.
So Job opens his mouth and says nothing worthwhile. He talks a lot without knowing anything."
